questions.question: Describe your experience with month-end close, including the journal entries, balance-sheet reconciliations, and financial-statement reviews you personally prepared or reviewed.

In your roles at Capital Group, Visa, or Accent Foods, what experience did you have reconciling accounts receivable or investigating reconciliation discrepancies? Please walk through a specific example.

This role requires accounting for revenue, unbilled receivables, deferred revenue, and AR reserves. What exposure have you had to these accounts, and how would you approach reconciling them at month-end?
What is your understanding of ASC 606, and how would you evaluate revenue recognition for a contract that includes a product sale, software license, and ongoing service component?
Tell us about a time you identified an error, inconsistency, or unusual fluctuation in financial data. How did you investigate it, resolve it, and document the outcome?
You have supported SOX controls and audit activities. What controls have you worked with that help ensure the accuracy and completeness of accounting entries and account reconciliations?
Describe your experience coordinating audit requests, preparing audit support, and working with external auditors or advisors. How did you ensure requests were complete and delivered on time?

At Visa, you worked with Corporate and Regional FP&A and Finance Business Partners. How have you explained accounting results, variance drivers, or reconciliation issues to non-accounting stakeholders?

Monarch is building and scaling accounting processes. Can you provide an example of a process, procedure, or documentation improvement you implemented or helped develop in a finance or accounting function?

Which accounting systems have you used most extensively, including Oracle R11/R12, SAP, Great Plains, QuickBooks, or others? What was your role in using those systems for general ledger accounting, reconciliations, reporting, or close activities?
